newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended quietly firmer after gaining in the final hour of a shortened session ahead of a long New Year's holiday.
The market will be closed Wednesday. Zurich banks remain shut on Thursday. Trade will reopen on Friday.
One Swiss bond trader said the market was generally dormant, but there had been some activity in the short end.

"In the short end, people are paying higher prices," the trader said. He said the short end appeared to be bid up on speculation that the dollar could correct after recent gains against the Swiss franc.

The dollar hit a roughly 2-1/2 year high of 1.3536 francs on Monday, and eased slightly on Tuesday. Swiss short-term rates tend to rise when investors short the Swiss franc, leading them to borrow francs.
